cues: Think of a rope wave passing through a slot.
If the rope shakes along the slot, the wave goes through.
Turn the slot across, and the wave is blocked.
A longitudinal wave, like sound, vibrates along its direction of travel, so turning the slot makes no difference at all.
text: Why does that prove anything? Think of a rope wave passing through a slot. If the rope shakes along the slot, the wave goes through. Turn the slot across, and the wave is blocked. A longitudinal wave, like sound, vibrates along its direction of travel, so turning the slot makes no difference at all.
